[[File:Tie_fighters.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A flight of TIE fighters]]
A '''flight group''' or '''group''' was a unit of three, four or five [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], depending on the military, that was typically though not always led by a [[Captain/Legends|captain]]. Three flights of four starfighters, or four flights of three starfighters, typically made up a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]]. Many military organizations, such as the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] and [[New Republic Starfighter Command/Legends|New Republic Starfighter Command]], used this system of intra-squadron organization. It was also utilized within [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] units. In the Imperial Navy, a flight group consisted of three squadrons of twelve fighters each.

[[General/Legends|General]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] often led flight groups of two to four, while just as frequently flying solo.
